parameters.name: network

parameters.description: SUNSWAP V2 router contract address.

parameters.description: Token A contract address.

parameters.description: Desired amount of token A (raw units).

parameters.name: amountBDesired
parameters.description: Desired amount of token B (raw units).

parameters.name: amountAMin
parameters.description: Minimum amount of token A to add. If omitted, defaults to amountADesired with a 5% slippage buffer.

parameters.name: amountBMin
parameters.description: Minimum amount of token B to add. If omitted, defaults to amountBDesired with a 5% slippage buffer.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Recipient address for LP tokens. If omitted, defaults to the active wallet address.

parameters.name: deadline

custom.name: sunswap_v2_remove_liquidity
custom.description: Remove liquidity from a SUNSWAP V2-style pool. If tokenA or tokenB is native TRX (T9yD14Nj9j7xAB4dbGeiX9h8unkKHxuWwb), removeLiquidityETH is used automatically; otherwise removeLiquidity(...) is used.

parameters.name: network
parameters.description: TRON network: mainnet, nile, or shasta (default: mainnet)

parameters.name: routerAddress
parameters.description: SUNSWAP V2 router contract address.

parameters.name: abi

parameters.name: tokenA
parameters.description: Token A underlying contract address in the V2 pool (LP token is derived automatically from the factory).

parameters.name: tokenB

parameters.name: liquidity
parameters.description: Amount of LP tokens to burn.

parameters.name: amountAMin
parameters.description: Minimum amount of token A to receive. If omitted, it is computed from pool reserves based on the LP share with a 5% slippage buffer.

parameters.name: amountBMin
parameters.description: Minimum amount of token B to receive. If omitted, it is computed from pool reserves based on the LP share with a 5% slippage buffer.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Recipient of underlying tokens. If omitted, defaults to the active wallet address.

parameters.name: deadline
parameters.description: Unix timestamp deadline for the transaction. If omitted, defaults to now + 30 minutes.

custom.name: sunswap_v3_mint_position
custom.description: Mint a new SUNSWAP V3 concentrated liquidity position. Supports auto-compute: if fee is omitted, defaults to 3000; if tickLower/tickUpper are omitted, reads pool currentTick and sets ±50*tickSpacing; if only one of amount0Desired/amount1Desired is provided, calculates the other from V3 math.

parameters.name: network
parameters.description: TRON network: mainnet, nile, or shasta (default: mainnet)

parameters.name: positionManagerAddress
parameters.description: SUNSWAP V3 NonfungiblePositionManager contract address.

parameters.name: abi
parameters.description: Optional position manager ABI; if omitted, TronWeb will attempt to infer it.

parameters.name: token0
parameters.description: Token0 contract address.

parameters.name: token1
parameters.description: Token1 contract address.

parameters.name: fee
parameters.description: Pool fee tier (e.g. 100, 500, 3000). Defaults to 3000 if omitted.

parameters.name: tickLower
parameters.description: Lower tick. If omitted, auto-set to currentTick - 50*tickSpacing.

parameters.name: tickUpper
parameters.description: Upper tick. If omitted, auto-set to currentTick + 50*tickSpacing.

parameters.name: amount0Desired
parameters.description: Desired amount of token0 (raw units). If only one side is provided, the other is auto-calculated.

parameters.name: amount1Desired
parameters.description: Desired amount of token1 (raw units). If only one side is provided, the other is auto-calculated.

parameters.name: amount0Min
parameters.description: Minimum amount of token0. Defaults to amount0Desired * 95%.

parameters.name: amount1Min
parameters.description: Minimum amount of token1. Defaults to amount1Desired * 95%.

parameters.name: recipient
parameters.description: Recipient of the position NFT. Defaults to active wallet.

parameters.name: deadline
parameters.description: Unix timestamp deadline. Defaults to now + 30 minutes.

custom.name: sunswap_v3_increase_liquidity
custom.description: Increase liquidity of an existing SUNSWAP V3 position. If only one of amount0Desired/amount1Desired is provided along with token0/token1/fee, the other is auto-calculated. amountMin defaults to 5% slippage; deadline defaults to now + 30 min.

parameters.name: network
parameters.description: TRON network: mainnet, nile, or shasta (default: mainnet)

parameters.name: positionManagerAddress

parameters.name: abi

parameters.name: tokenId
parameters.description: Token ID of the V3 position NFT.

parameters.name: token0
parameters.description: Token0 address. Required for single-sided auto-compute and approval.

parameters.name: token1
parameters.description: Token1 address. Required for single-sided auto-compute and approval.

parameters.name: fee
parameters.description: Pool fee tier for pool lookup. Defaults to 3000.

parameters.name: tickLower
parameters.description: Lower tick override. If omitted, reads from the existing on-chain position.

parameters.name: tickUpper
parameters.description: Upper tick override. If omitted, reads from the existing on-chain position.

parameters.name: amount0Desired
parameters.description: Desired additional amount of token0. Auto-computed if only amount1Desired is given.

parameters.name: amount1Desired
parameters.description: Desired additional amount of token1. Auto-computed if only amount0Desired is given.

parameters.name: amount0Min
parameters.description: Minimum additional token0. Defaults to amount0Desired * 95%.

parameters.name: amount1Min
parameters.description: Minimum additional token1. Defaults to amount1Desired * 95%.

parameters.name: deadline
parameters.description: Unix timestamp deadline. Defaults to now + 30 minutes.

custom.name: sunswap_v3_decrease_liquidity
custom.description: Decrease liquidity of an existing SUNSWAP V3 position. If token0/token1/fee are provided, amount0Min/amount1Min are auto-calculated from V3 math with 5% slippage. deadline defaults to now + 30 min.
